name: Platform Directory
description: The canonical, tenant-level data model owned by the PLATFORM (not by any app): people/org, hierarchy, departments, and access groups. Every app references these instead of defining its own 'employee'. Apps reference them via a reference field with targetApp='platform'. Person is separate from the login User (control-plane identity) and optionally links to it. TEAMS are the org structure: 'group' is every team, 'department' is the top-level teams, and a person's department is their primary team. HR attributes (job title, employment data, salary) deliberately do NOT live here — they belong to an HR app, which models them far better than a login identity can.

entities.label: Person
entities.description: Workforce/org record. May exist without a login; links to a control-plane User when the person can sign in.

fields.label: Manager
fields.help: The org hierarchy — used for approvals, delegation, escalation.

fields.label: Has Login
fields.help: True when this person is linked to a control-plane User (managed by the platform).

entities.label: Department
entities.description: A top-level team. Departments and groups are two views over the one org structure: every department IS a team, and teams nest.

entities.label: Group
entities.description: A team — the access/sharing unit. Teams NEST, and access granted to a team reaches every sub-team below it. The same teams drive SSO group→app mapping and permissions.
